background: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the holding company of the largest US bank, spanning consumer and community banking, the corporate and investment bank, commercial banking and asset and wealth management.
synthesis: JPMorgan Chase is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 15 Nov 2024. The one ratio shown for the holding company, leverage of 7.5%, is in the top quarter of US banks. The newest flagged item, on 2 Oct 2026, is an SEC censure without a fine for a supervision lapse, with rounds of job cuts before it, none of it bearing on credit.
